programme.title: 超级鲨鱼大道 #1
programme.desc: 来到澳洲南部水域,展开一场具挑战性的追踪任务,并揭示鲨鱼的食物来源和他们聚集于觅食热点的原因团队之后一路向北,追踪虎鲨、公牛鲨和锤头鲨,并为他们其中一员装上360度的背鳍摄像镜头

programme.title: 超级鲨鱼大道 #2
programme.desc: 沿著大堡礁追踪一条怀孕的鲨鱼,看看她能否带领科学家团队找到隐秘的生产地然后到南部海岸寻找求偶中的鲨鱼,并见证一条非常害羞的雌性巨鲨如何发现爱情

programme.title: 超级鲨鱼大道 #3
programme.desc: 与位处北方的科学家团队一起熬夜,他们尝试为一只公牛鲨装上追踪仪,看看这头夜猫子入夜后有何行踪然后与南方团队一起潜入80米深的海底,并尝试为一条雌性大白鲨装上卫星追踪器

programme.title: 超级鲨鱼大道 #4
programme.desc: 跟随北方研究团队窥探鲨鱼的社群层级结构,他们正在研究年轻的黑鳍鲨如何学习社交和生存技能然后与南方团队会合,一同前往彩虹海滩,他们渴望目睹沙虎鲨最难以捉摸的行为:交配

programme.title: 超级鲨鱼大道 #6

programme.title: 雪豹猎奇 #2

programme.title: 肯亚野生日记 #1
programme.desc: 尼华保育区正在努力让大象由肯雅山经过桑布鲁国家公园回到野外他们还创造了一个大象禁区,试图恢复受损的生态系统无线电跟踪项圈用于帮助环保学家更好地了解大象的需求,并观察牠们是否正返回栖息地

programme.title: 迷忘国度 #1
programme.desc: 了解世上最大的火山岛,一个孤独而崎岖不平的地方,蒸汽散逸,水花四溅,每天都有新土地诞生且看冰火交融如何打造地球上最强大的地质岛屿

programme.title: 迷忘国度 #2
programme.desc: 游览从前由冰雕凿而成,现在则是由火山建构的岛屿大约150万年前,一块冰地从北而下并覆盖了整片土地时至今日,巨大的冰川仍继续一边雕刻著海洋悬崖,一边砍伐山脉

programme.title: 迷忘国度 #3
programme.desc: 走进芬迪湾汹涌的水域了解这个东岸生态系统如何维持众多生物,当中包括成千上万的海鸟,世上最快的捕食者,以及复杂的无脊椎动物网络

programme.title: 迷忘国度 #4
programme.desc: 沿著大不列颠岛的西海岸,世上最长的无间断步道穿越超过800英里的壮丽景色威尔斯海岸的多样化景观简直是地质瑰宝

programme.title: 迷忘国度 #5
programme.desc: 爱尔兰虽小,但却充满奇迹它被大西洋、莫赫悬崖及至非凡的巨人堤道围绕,这土地一直被水力和强烈的地质力量所塑造和重塑

programme.title: 迷忘国度 #6
programme.desc: 温哥华岛的野生太平洋海岸是卑诗省西海岸的一片古老而崎岖的风貌从久远高山冰川的冰封山峰到加拿大浓雾盖顶的唯一雨林,它是北美最潮湿的地方,这片原始的栖息地,既是太平洋的命脉,亦是大自然与人文精神共存之地

programme.title: 扎根 #1
programme.desc: 在喀拉哈里南部的草原上,有一棵壮丽的骆驼刺树这棵相思树已经在此屹立了两个世纪在这片干旱的地貌中,这棵骆驼刺树是大大小小生物的避难所善于交际的织布鸟、绿豆象甲虫和各种哺乳类动物在喀拉哈里活用这棵标志性的树

programme.title: 扎根 #2
programme.desc: 这是备受喜爱的香肠树的浪漫故事博茨瓦纳东北角的塞林达保护区面临艰难的一年它十分干旱,雨季还有几个月才来到在如此具有挑战性的期间,许多鸟类和动物依靠香肠树来维持生计

programme.title: 扎根 #3
programme.desc: 索特潘斯山脉的高山地雨林中生长出巨大的奥特尼夸香槐树这是一个讲述了这棵巨大的树如何在她的枝梢中提供居所、饲养和庇护一众动植物的故事

programme.desc: 见证大白鲨群英的终极战斗!科学家们尝试从新西兰海岸外的100多条大白鲨中,挑选出领头的鲨王一起为群雄的速度、猎食技能和无比勇气而喝采

programme.title: 超级鲨鱼大道 #1
programme.desc: 来到澳洲南部水域,展开一场具挑战性的追踪任务,并揭示鲨鱼的食物来源和他们聚集于觅食热点的原因团队之后一路向北,追踪虎鲨、公牛鲨和锤头鲨,并为他们其中一员装上360度的背鳍摄像镜头

programme.title: 超级鲨鱼大道 #2
programme.desc: 沿著大堡礁追踪一条怀孕的鲨鱼,看看她能否带领科学家团队找到隐秘的生产地然后到南部海岸寻找求偶中的鲨鱼,并见证一条非常害羞的雌性巨鲨如何发现爱情

programme.title: 超级鲨鱼大道 #3
programme.desc: 与位处北方的科学家团队一起熬夜,他们尝试为一只公牛鲨装上追踪仪,看看这头夜猫子入夜后有何行踪然后与南方团队一起潜入80米深的海底,并尝试为一条雌性大白鲨装上卫星追踪器

programme.title: 超级鲨鱼大道 #4
programme.desc: 跟随北方研究团队窥探鲨鱼的社群层级结构,他们正在研究年轻的黑鳍鲨如何学习社交和生存技能然后与南方团队会合,一同前往彩虹海滩,他们渴望目睹沙虎鲨最难以捉摸的行为:交配

programme.title: 超级鲨鱼大道 #5
programme.desc: 探索澳洲超级鲨鱼大道的尽头,了解南方的格林利岛是否大白鲨迁徙路线的中途站,然后寻找北方牛鲨与生活在较冷气候的表亲,以及他们之间的基因联系证据

programme.title: 超级鲨鱼大道 #6
programme.desc: 跟随南方团队测试新的追踪鲨鱼技术和工具,可望减少在热门浮潜地点的鲨鱼攻击然后与北方团队一起追踪牛鲨;科学家们希望帮助当地游泳者避开即将分娩的母牛鲨

programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners Their large size is one of their features Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets

programme.desc: At the turn of the century, a Child-Emperor ascended to the throne of the Chinese Qing Dynasty Emperor Pu-Yi’s Reign was short lived and mired with treason, corruption and external influences After abdicating his throne, Pu Yi knew his days in the imperial palace were numbered Questions of his survival as a commoner began to trouble his mind Upon looking at the wealth of priceless artifacts collected over 500 years of imperial reign, Pu Yi began plotting ways to smuggle these riches out However, Pu Yi was not alone Discover China brings you the story of how the precious treasures of the Imperial City disappeared from the capital palace, and where some reside today

programme.title: The Huddle
programme.desc: Though separated by a stretch of sea, Glasgow and Belfast share elements of political, sporting and religious culture rooted in the difficult, unresolved events faced by the Irish community during the twentieth century The Huddle tells the stories of two Irish communities brought together by a devotion to the Celtic Football Club, and a shared faith in football Exploring the contradictions between two cities facing radical ideological divides yet brought together by full stadiums, these are the interwoven and personal accounts of journalists, musicians, political militants, IRA fighters—all united by their love of football—on what it means to be Irish

programme.title: 灵修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透过诗歌安静心灵,从牧者及嘉宾的分享学习《圣经》中的真理,让观众由浅入深认识信仰,默想《圣经》教导。

programme.title: 「创世电视福音主日」-不由你不信之从万物创造到深邃的爱
programme.desc: 「超阔银幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大众化的福音主题」,加上「诚意的款待」会产生极致的「福音体验」。梁明彪博士分享上帝如何从人类各器官的精密构造,看到上帝创造是多么奇妙伟大,每个人的出生就是一场最严谨的监制,原来正常的生命就是一场神迹。在领受上帝创造恩典之时,明白祂在创造过程对人的慈爱和关怀。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人说,人生是一场戏,在人生的过程中,寻找有时、碰壁有时、迷失有时、觉醒有时,说真的,这些起承转合比真正的电影情节更精彩,每一个「你」,都是天父特别设计的人生剧本主角。 今天,我们的世界充满了末世风情,醉生梦死、迷失自我了结生命的悲剧每天上演,创世电视藉100个见证故事挽救生命,100位来自世界各地

programme.title: 如果还有明天5 我为上帝精彩过
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下错车,弄得满身伤痕、万劫不复,惟有祂并不介意我们的过去,愿意领我们走向美好的将来。《如果还有明天5我为上帝精彩过》,深入中国广西山区孤儿院,记录残障青年在信仰中找回尊严和盼望的故事。摄制队再远赴南半球,见证澳洲天生失明女歌手及轮椅上的妈妈,突破身体局限活出主爱无限;还有美国摘冠

programme.title: 葛培理牧师特辑
programme.desc: 节目记录葛培理布道团最新福音事工,并葛培理牧师70年来布道的足迹及对世界各地的贡献,让我们面对不同的世情,仍然把握机会传福音。

programme.title: 圣地流动教室-以色列破谜之旅
programme.desc: 通晓中西方历史、文学、艺术、民间传说的学者吴宗文牧师,以及主持梁艺龄,透过镜头带著电视观众,去到圣地各站游历,呈现出新旧约的《圣经》典故、历史文献的记载、相关的犹太传说和传统习俗,而更重要是从耶稣和初期信徒的记载,带出人生的重要特质,助你成就非凡人生。

高朋满座#235粤
programme.desc: 喜跟庆到云南作义诊，欲选出新一任高家「话事人」，竟让义当选。义大洒金钱满足众人要求，花指义此举将使高家陷入赤字，但义依然故我。朋要悦了解溢的工作情况，悦与义发现溢遭上司欺负，义为此聘请溢到药房工作。

programme.title: 说英雄谁是英雄#6粤普PG
programme.desc: 小石带著温柔跟踪傅宗书，要给他一个教训，之后二人路经市集，听到有人落水，小石立刻下水救人。落水的人是方应看，他得知温柔的身分后，表明曾与她结下了姻亲。温柔对应看轻佻的态度很不屑，但应看却对她很有兴趣。

阿妈教落食平D粤
programme.desc: 购入波士顿龙虾，连同多款配料及酥皮，焗出浓味的西汤「酥皮龙虾汤」，平价煮出好滋味。另一道西式「虾小菜」，是将煎过的琵琶虾放入法国牛油软包之中，味道媲美龙虾！将萝卜丝水份释出，加入面粉、鸡蛋及调味拌匀后炸，再洒樱花虾干，便做出怀旧的「萝卜饼」。用猛火炸𪮶尿虾是厨房常识，想做「避风塘𪮶尿虾」还需甚么调味料？用酥皮面线卷着虎虾烤成的「奇妙金丝虾」，讲求的技巧众多，快快抄下重点！

programme.title: 航向未来粤
programme.desc: 运输及物流局积极推动本港的海空联运，节目《航向未来》由星级艺员吴伟豪、郭柏妍担纲演出，并饰演初到海运前线的实习生，透过实况情节，介绍当局如何精准高效地协调货船泊进港口后，把船上货物经香港转运出海，继而运往世界各地，同时为国际航运业绿色减碳出力。

programme.title: 流行都市粤 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特约：健康一分钟粤
programme.desc: 胸椎弧度一旦超过五十度便会界定为寒背，并可分为功能性与结构性两类。脊医除了细说两者的不同成因外，更提到严重功能性寒背有可能威胁心肺健康。脊医还以「先放松、后强化」为准则，示范相关运动。两位女生早前参与世界技能大赛，分别于橱窗设计及西点制作项目勇夺优异奖章，她们到来畅谈赛前准备与比赛点滴。二人透露曾受赛场温度影响，全靠临场应变化解危机。「睇𩠌食饭」，厨艺专家傅季馨带来「脆脆紫菜鲮鱼饼」，香口惹味。

programme.title: 拍档厨房粤
programme.desc: 张曦雯伙同梁伟灏，徐荣和谭咏仪组队，从「拍档联乘」启动对垒，徐荣演戏前原来曾是厨师！检视两队餐单，评判帜哥认为菜式相对简单？看到咏仪制作「话梅莲藕烤麸」时，把烤麸上脆浆油炸，众评判即有所期待。曦雯队的头盘「慢煮三文鱼流心温泉蛋」，控制温度是关键！主菜方面，徐荣队巧制「松叶蟹戒米饭」够健康，他处理「炒饭」的刀法、抛镬亦有板有眼。曦雯队的烟熏白鸽胸利梳多饭，鸽胸经熏、煎、焗三重步骤，帜哥提到仍有缺点？

programme.title: 大帅哥#11粤PG
programme.desc: 狄奇为筹措军费征收人头税，民怨沸腾！此时少帅突然失踪，狄奇心知是谁搞鬼，接纳沅婉建议退税。狄奇一计不成，决定举办盆菜宴，向镇民痛陈利弊，游说军队攻打禄丰镇……细龟、佘南互相不肯撤离禄丰镇，英俊提供一个双赢的方法。马炭、罗义讨论攻镇策略，被落芦批评得体无完肤，声称只有一个方法才能成功。出战前夕，沅婉要求加入大军任军医，狄奇断然拒绝，安排三女各司其职。大军出发前，狄奇发现三女乔装潜入军队……

programme.title: 方德证券独家呈现:交易现场粤 及 方德证券独家呈现:交易先机粤
樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 英叔生日将至，花轮同学询问小丸子意见，最后决定大家一起为英叔庆生，给他一个惊喜。小丸子是龟族的一份子，为了不再让其他动物小看龟族，小丸子等龟族毅然求教龟爷爷，并向兔族作出挑战。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，这集两节训练需要用上不同工具，集齐小健身球及两个水樽，就可开始做热身。保持V-Sit姿势或躺下后抬起脚，再推移健身球，有助强化核心肌力。接下来的动作更具挑战，双手双脚踏实在地，抬起臀部前后移动的同时，也不能让放于腹部的健身球掉下来！第二轮要大家在指定距离之间完成锻练，并以水樽作标示。向左右跳步、抬脚伸向不同方向等动作都只靠单脚支撑，好好训练平衡力与稳定度。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粤日
programme.desc: 又来到一年一度的校舍清洁比赛。朱莉亚与咏瑠虽为室友，却碍于性格回异，经常吵架。于是，她俩便乘着这个机会，在比赛中尽情较量。另一方面，阳葵与美月作为两支队伍的队长，竟将对决丢到一旁，和睦地一起打扫。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 新闻掏宝粤 及 潮流生活志之时尚头条粤
programme.desc: 现代社会人浮于事，年轻人想找工作绝对不易，政府和社福机构都为年轻人举行培训，甚至帮他们找雇主试工，成效有多大？新闻掏宝和大家重温1999年专题。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 汇丰Premier Elite呈献：《汇丰Premier Elite财富汇谈》粤 及 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 金融市场瞬息万变，加上科技发展日新月异，如何影响投资市场？《汇丰Premier Elite财富汇谈》，云集不同行业专家，剖析市场趋势，讲解金融、投资及理财等话题，务求做到深入浅出，聚焦分析不同议题，为大家捕捉市场先机。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱．回家之三代同糖#77粤
programme.desc: 朱基因龚喜一句话，不惜潜入外国博物馆盗取宝物，成了国际通辑犯；龚喜却习以为常，毫不担心。龚喜得悉前男友Steven来港注册结婚，遂与嘉冰前往搞破坏。嘉冰等人因此得知龚喜曾遭他陷害入狱，朱基不惜身陷囹圄相救。Steven趁朱基出埠处理盗宝风波，派人绑架龚喜与嘉冰，势要与龚喜一刀两断，并道出当年分手及龚喜入狱的真相。朱基赶至救人，揭穿「真相的另一面」；混乱间，Steven向朱基掷飞刀，龚喜飞扑挡刀……

programme.title: 保诚保险呈献：玫瑰战争#13粤PG
programme.desc: 无双与菲雅达成协议，联手调查行迹可疑的绮云。无双向云生提出合资建设串流平台与实体影城，并以竞选电影总会主席为条件。云生命凤仪搜集现任主席黑材料逼其退选，绮云深感地位危机，二女针锋相对。菲雅顺利亲近绮云，无双付酬让素希中止任务，没料素希另有想法。凤仪以生日会争夺云生身旁的女主人地位，并刻意支开绮云……德龙为阻止宝儿与父亲相认，竟在凤仪的生日会上闹事。绮云终返港，却没有前往生日会……

programme.title: 丰隆旅游保险呈献：跟风旅行团粤 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特约：健康一分钟粤
programme.desc: 节目组预备了三段百万级点击影片，让如风猜数字及排序。爱好酱油蟹的如风轻易吃掉桌上四只蟹，得知食店采放题制，即刻要追加！她听到价钱，更加哗一声！商场内有个动物园，如风尝试接近园内多类动物，甚至准备喂食，但她似乎没甚么「动物缘」。环境甚普通的连锁炸鸡店，却被网民封为韩国三大炸鸡店？如风尝过招牌「薯仔炸鸡」后，大为改观，连幕后人员都几乎忘记还有另一款炸鸡要介绍！这集还有如风私心推介的「稀有包包收藏库」。

programme.title: 武则天#34粤普
programme.desc: 世民设局试探媚娘是否坦白李牧身分，她为护李牧偷烧卷宗，终令世民失望。媚娘发现李牧背负血仇，求杨妃安排二人离宫。

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 环球新闻档案粤

programme.desc: 在瑞士坐巴士，下车前要按钟，还要自行按掣开门？不如参观交通博物馆，认识更多当地的交通规则，还可大玩特玩多种游戏，难怪阿萧说想不到参观博物馆会咁攰！乘缆车登上皮拉图斯山看云海，不过挑战绳网才是重点，原来绳网可令某人的强悍形象瞬间破坏，亦令阿廉这位「长者」顿变成「少女」倾慕的对象，子羚还提议他接拍《特技人2》担任主角……的替身！在轨道上滑行过千米落山同样刺激，换来速度感及满足感，为何有人成为「笑柄」？

programme.title: 如果这样生活粤PG
programme.desc: 李佳芯(Ali)用青春放手一搏，展开了不被看好的演艺路，就如这次西藏之旅，充满历险和未知。Ali踏单车从拉萨起步，途经村落小茶馆与藏民同乐，亲见神圣小布达拉宫，还入乡随俗看藏医，怎么被诊断出有「神经病」？经过惊险「108道拐」，Ali在珠穆朗玛峰前，回想演艺路上的人情冷暖，到现在获肯定，满满感动。Ali认识一位「乐天使者」，纵然半身瘫痪，但她的乐观、潇洒感染了Ali，还教Ali克服对滑雪的恐惧。

programme.title: 世界养生组织粤
programme.desc: 今时今日问10个人有什么愿望，9个人会答:身体健康！这些日子，疫症肆虐，人人都要增强抵抗力，才能与病毒共存；拉阔点看，人类平均寿命延长了，不好好保养自己等老了体弱多病的话，苦了自己也苦了家人，怎过意得去！

programme.title: 双祥见粤
programme.desc: 两位祥哥教大家弄五青汁以及清血果汁，提倡健康饮食！二人更分享入行以来所见过艺人所犯的「死症」。MEN’S TALK环节则解构男人的压力：主要从何而来? 又有咩减压方法?

programme.title: 香港本色粤
programme.desc: 蛋挞、菠萝包、港式奶茶、鸳鸯等地道港式滋味的制作技艺，被列入非物质文化遗产名单。西环老字号茶餐厅负责人周锡丰制作蛋挞的经验丰富，但他仍然认为制作过程非常困难，对他而言，哪个步骤最考工夫？「金茶王」冠军级人马梁德酬认为要冲出一杯靓奶茶，最重要是水滚茶靓，他大方分享冲茶技巧。另一位「金茶王」冠军人马林少昂，以冲调香港独有的鸳鸯闻名，他曾参与美国交流活动，当中有何难忘经历？

programme.title: 美食一条街 顺德篇粤
programme.desc: 顺德觅食之旅，由大良华盖路步行街开始，大良炖奶有新花款，邝洁楹对「首创」亦有新定义！伦教糕即白糖糕，加蛋煎制又有何新火花？拜访顺德网红名厨，「鱼羊鲜」和「岳母鸡」令人难忘；走进由机械人主理的火锅店，落单、送餐、甜品制作全智能化，眼界大开！还有另类「水晶料理」，莫非要把水晶吞入口中？即叫即烧的炭火烧鸡与烧排骨，远近驰名，三位哈比女主持都给予高评价。旅程尾声一尝混入黑米的煲仔饭，最让人惊喜的却是价格！

programme.title: 细味文明粤英
programme.desc: 遨游全世界最受欢迎且充满美态与魅力的旅游胜地，欣赏美妙的天然奇景、引人入胜的古迹、精湛的手工艺和迷人的景色。带观众踏上难忘的旅程，融入梦想旅游目的地的传统与历史里。

programme.title: 夫妇的世界
programme.desc: 【闺蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宫血洗渣男小三】医院副院长池善雨拥有令人羡慕的完美生活，却因一根神秘发丝，惊觉导演丈夫早已出轨富家千金，且身边挚友全都是帮忙隐瞒的帮凶。面对爱情与友情的双重背叛，彻底心碎的她不再隐忍，决心化身复仇女神。她智商在线地精心设局，利用财产、孩子与社会地位作为筹码，与丈夫展开一场玉石俱焚的心理战与利益争夺，将虚伪的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎。

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 南风知我意
programme.desc: 【《莲花楼》成毅在搭张予曦，再现《与君歌》绝美默契！！】药物研发员傅云深与外科医生朱旧至偏乡进行人道医疗救援，两人从误解到经历生死危机而两情相悦，彼此还不及坦承心意就遭逢巨变，从此断绝联系。一年后的重逢，面对傅云深的刁难与变化，朱旧坚韧及乐观并不离不弃的守候，陪他度过每个春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 吹吧微风
programme.desc: 【千亿遗产考验林智妍沦落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一场跨越南北的失散命运，意外揭开千亿财产背后的血缘骗局。脱北女孩微风重返南韩，与多年不见的初恋律师长高重逢，却被卷入豪门争产与身世之谜。冒名孙女设局夺产，谎言层层堆叠，亲情逐渐崩裂；长高的母亲强势介入，以门第与前途逼迫儿子放弃真爱。当真相一一曝光，有人为贪念付出惨痛代价，有人失去一切。被牺牲的爱情，是否还能在命运翻转后，迎来真正的团圆？

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破脸！命运抓弄下的同居奇迹】一场毁灭性的家庭变故，让原本关系紧绷的离婚婆婆、媳妇与小姑，命运交织地被迫同住在一个屋簷下。撕下以往的对立标签，三个性格迥异、伤痕累累的女人在满是摩擦与冲突的日常中，渐渐看清彼此的脆弱。她们相互扶持、携手抵御人生的逆境风浪，最终走出阴霾，共筑出比血缘更坚固的暖心情谊！

programme.title: 金装律师
programme.desc: 【改编人气美国影集，张东健×朴炯植联手成为法律界黄金拍档！！】头脑聪明，拥有过目不忘天才能力的高延宇，却因家境关系却步成为律师。混进了律师事务所遇上韩国顶级资深律师崔江锡。随著事件发生与时间相处成为黄金拍档，崔江锡要如何亦师亦友的带著没有正式念过大学也只是菜鸟律师的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 汉摩拉比小姐
programme.desc: 【高雅罗×金明洙×成东镒，三人三色法官个性，寻找法庭正义！！】三位个性截然不同的法官，在现实与理想间的挣扎与选择。热血直率的新任法官及冷静理性的资深法官同事。每一场审判，都是对人性与制度的考验。在案件背后，他们不只判案，更在学习如何面对自己心中的「正义」。

programme.title: 风起西州
programme.desc: 【《风起霓裳》最新续作！！许魏洲、古力娜扎续夫妻情缘，琴瑟和鸣的婚后生活及事业新考验！！】制衣才女库狄琉璃与裴行俭婚后面对大长公主的屡次使计刁难，琉璃聪慧应对，化险为夷。裴行俭因意外被贬远赴西州上任，夫妻携手同心，琉璃发挥自己的长才，传授西州百姓制衣技巧。裴行俭则守护西州百姓经济富足、安居乐业。

programme.title: 金装律师

programme.title: 双轨
programme.desc: 【何与×虞书欣伪骨科继兄妹禁忌爱恋，从爱妹到暧昧火花四射！！】姜暮9岁前是被家人宠在手心的小女孩，靳朝是天之骄子的哥哥。那年父母离婚，两人命运自此走上双轨，爸爸和哥哥移居泰国，成为地下赛车与拳场中的修车工。多年后，19岁的姜暮得知哥哥是被领养的秘密，瞒著所有人独自飞往泰国。在泰国的租屋中两人展开了一段隐秘而甜蜜的情感旅程，在光明与黑暗间重逢，禁忌拉扯中双向救赎。

programme.title: 逆转女王
programme.desc: 【经典韩剧《贤内助女王》姊妹作】黄泰熙原是高薪的开发组长，但为了追求幸福家庭，她选择与新同事奉俊秀结婚。然而她的决定，却让她被信任的女上司赶出公司，只能在家当贤内助。五年后，泰熙感到现实生活的沉重，决定重返职场。在公司她遇见了具勇植，一位支持她的本部长。泰熙在勇植的鼓励下展现出更坚韧的一面，最终成功东山再起，找到了新的事业目标。

programme.title: 等待京道(完)
programme.desc: 【朴叙俊回归携手《鱿鱼2》元志安《等待京道》谱十年宿命恋】十年后的重逢，让李京道与徐智友再度陷入爱情的漩涡。曾是彼此初恋的两人，如今一个是追寻真相的记者，一个是丑闻风暴中的名门继承人。再见面时，他们早已不是年少时的模样，却依然在对方身上看见过去的自己。爱情与现实的距离，在一次次试探与退让间拉扯，他们明知前方满是荆棘，仍选择再次并肩。

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韩版《罗马假期》霸总宋慧乔恋上暖男朴宝剑】出身政客家庭的车秀贤，为了家族牺牲爱情、步入无爱的婚姻，离婚后的人生空虚苍白；金振赫是怀抱梦想的平凡青年，用热情拥抱世界。两人在异国邂逅，相知相爱，却因身分悬殊而痛苦分离。多年后重逢，她已是冷静自持的上司，他是刚入职的新进员工。过往的甜蜜与伤痕浮现，情感再度悄然蔓延。她挣扎于曾经的选择，他则努力冲破阶级的枷锁。爱情，能否再次在现实的夹缝中绽放？

programme.title: 我亲爱的朋友们
programme.desc: 【老人也有春天！七十岁的我们 终于学会说不】她们是一群走过风雨的老人，曾为家庭默默奉献，如今选择为自己绽放。一场聚会重新牵起年少情谊，也掀开多年压抑的心事。有人鼓起勇气离婚，搬进梦想中的小屋；有人在意外后学会面对过错，重拾友情的信任；有人对抗失智，却仍记得朋友的名字与笑声。女儿朴莞在倾听中理解母亲，在书写中记录她们的光芒。人生未晚，她们手牵著手，用皱纹写下温柔，也用笑声走向崭新的旅程。

programme.title: 只属于我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律师劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆袭成知名设计师】恩静与律师姜胜宰结婚后，原以为会享受奢华生活，但现实却是在婆家被当成佣人使唤。婆婆因恩静没有家世而感到丢脸，胜宰也渐渐冷淡，甚至不愿承认老婆。事实上，恩静发现胜宰根本没有办理结婚登记，当她为了帮助妹妹处理财务问题，办理贷款时才揭露了这个真相。不久后她发现老公与BJ集团继承人有染，决心离开伤心地，重返职场成为知名设计师。与此同时，昔日男友俊夏重新进入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能给她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 女医明妃传
programme.desc: 【刘诗诗淡妆出镜美出新高度，妙手仁心成明朝一代女国医！！】女子地位低下的大明，不得从医也难治隐疾。杭允贤从小耳濡目染，偷偷随祖母学习中医知识，不仅在学医道路上面临重重的困难和阻碍，更要面对封建礼教和世俗观念的冲击。开创并建立女医制度，从救人身体到救人灵魂，悬壶济世、妙手仁心的名声，得到普通百姓的赞扬和支持。

programme.title: 装腔启示录
programme.desc: 初级律师唐影在上海红圈律所工作，意外结识了合作方许子诠。虽然二人暗生情愫，却始终没有勇气直面真实的情感。两人历经多次事件，最终在唐影的帮助下，许子诠驱散了多年阴影，敢于直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在许子诠的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真实的一面。

programme.title: 完全省钱恋爱手册
programme.desc: 【精打细算的恋爱，郭书瑶vs林子闳金钱价值观保卫战，有钱没钱都要爱！！】不追求恋爱的节俭会计师上班族简可可，平易近人做事俐落、个性率直又善良。碰上了花钱如流水的同事王海阔，是能力强、业界有名的王牌业务。对彼此逐渐动心的爱情，两人的金钱价值观却大大不同，要如何在爱情与面包做选择呢?

programme.title: 九尾狐传
programme.desc: 【人间九尾狐李栋旭苦等初恋大谈人狐千年禁忌恋！！】活在现代的九尾狐李砚，身兼著阎罗王姐姐的阴间使者指令，斩妖除魔苦苦等候初恋南智雅转世千年在今生相遇，做为半人半妖的同父异母弟弟李朗，频频与李砚作对搅局。过去亲情、爱情、友情的磨难及错误的种子，在此世会得到解答吗?

Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Misha, the Purple Cat
programme.desc: Misha is a very lively, alert cat. She is very interested in investigating everything going on around her, which means she has some very entertaining adventures with her friends. programme.desc: The Feral family plans to blend in when they move into a new neighbourhood. But their son is no ordinary teenager. When he gets closer to his new neighbour, his thirst for blood grows and his difference becomes impossible to hide.

programme.title: Two of a Kind
programme.desc: What if your long-lost twin was your complete opposite? Sparks fly when a struggling handyman and a privileged politician discover they share identical DNA and one is black, the other is white! Culture clashes and chaos erupt. How did this happen?

programme.title: Dreaming Of The Meridian Arc
programme.desc: Dreaming of the Meridian Arc bridges present-day Japan and the Edo period through the efforts of hardworking civil servants who uncover the truth behind legendary cartographer Inō Tadataka's map of Japan and the unsung heroes who helped bring it into fruition.

programme.title: Mountain Woman
programme.desc: When famine overruns a small Japanese village, Rin must leave the village in order to protect her father accused of theft. Rin heads deep into Mt. Hayachin, and crosses the forbidden mountain god's shrine, where the goddess of thieves is said to dwell.

programme.title: El Alamein - The Line of Fire
programme.desc: Against a backdrop of searing daytime heat and chilling nighttime cold, three-time Italian Academy Awards winner Enzo Monteleone paints a gritty, powerful WW II epic of the Italian army’s battle with the Germans to drive Allied Forces from North Africa.

programme.title: Sarah Kohr: Cement
programme.desc: After waking in a hospital with no memory, Sarah Kohr is accused of shooting an innocent man following a violent accident. Determined to clear her name, she sets out to uncover the truth of what really happened that night.

programme.title: Adidas vs. Puma - That's The Name Of The Game!
programme.desc: This is the story of brothers Adi and Rudi who would go on to head two of the world’s most popular sportswear empires, Adidas and Puma. Rivalry between their wives rips them apart and the hatred and bitterness behind the brands take on epic proportions.

programme.title: Djam
programme.desc: Djam, a bold young Greek woman, travels to Istanbul to look for an engine part for her uncle’s boat. She meets a stranded and penniless Avril, who is a volunteer for Syrian refugees. Together, they embark on a lively, music-filled journey to Mytilene.

programme.title: Empty Nets
programme.desc: Amir loves Narges and Narges loves Amir. But their hopes and dreams for a life together collide head on with the web of tradition, corruption, and social hierarchy that continues to rule over the lives of a new generation in Iran.

programme.title: Midnight At The Paradise
programme.desc: Over the course of one evening, three couples are pulled into a collision course of sexual chemistry, delusion, forgiveness and hope as they explore what love, death, desire and the magic of the movies mean to them.

programme.title: Snow
programme.desc: In the heart of winter, several notables are found murdered. To advance investigations, Captain Delhaye decides to bring Juliette Hémon out of prison for a few days. The young woman had been imprisoned some years earlier for a strangely similar case.

programme.title: Spread Your Wings
programme.desc: One unforgettable summer could change everything. When a city teen joins his scientist father on a daring mission to guide endangered geese across Europe, an extraordinary adventure takes flight amid breathtaking landscapes and family bonds.

programme.title: Bermuda Triangle North Sea
programme.desc: Ships disappearing, wind farms collapsing, flocks of seagulls falling from the sky - what does the giant energy firm have to do with the mysterious calamities in the North Sea? Tom, a pilot, and Marie, the energy firm’s PR chief, uncover a horrible truth.

programme.title: Electric Wongaloo

programme.title: Running On Sand

programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggee's cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. There's a big match ahead...

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Waiting Badge

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Good Choices
programme.desc: The Squirrels haven't been making good choices round the messy clubhouse. With Duggee's help, they start to get it right. But not before sending Roly's imagination into overdrive!

programme.desc: Mojo and Bo need Ted's help to pull a wobbly duck statue up Swoppiton Hill. But does Ted know the best way? And will there be anything left of the duck when they get there?

programme.desc: Evil Pea tries to trap Supertato down the back of a sofa but falls in too. Luckily, they meet Raisin, who lives there with her buttons and knows the only way out.

programme.desc: Bluey, Snickers, and Winton are on their way to ask Calypso for help with their problems, when they are ambushed by the Terriers and use their unique talents to get past.

programme.desc: Mum reminisces about Bluey and Judo as babies. Bluey learnt to roll over first, but Judo was the first to crawl, so then it became a race to see who was going to walk first.

programme.desc: Bora and Brody get Pio to show feverish Finn how a kangaroos in the Australian outback keep cool in the heat.

programme.title: Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S01 - Albatross, Bird that Rides the Wind
programme.desc: Everyone learns about the gliding bird that is the Albatross. It soars without flapping it's wings! But how?!

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions S01 - Andy and the Puma Cubs
programme.desc: Andy, Jen &amp; Scout head to Patagonia, in South America on a baby animal mission in search of mother puma and her four cubs.

programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: Three rookie constables refuse to collude with corrupt officials, making themselves targets of a deadly conspiracy. After losing comrades and witnessing the abuse of power, they abandon all hope of justice. Determined to avenge the fallen, they launch a bloody assault on the corrupt forces in a desperate fight for justice.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: Love without End(1961)
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: Chancellor Qin Hui forges twelve gold medallions to recall General Yue Fei from the war's front line. Swordsman Miao Lung leads heroes to intercept them, only to find their leader is his mentor, Jin Yan Tang. Torn between loyalty and duty, the two clash in a duel. Miao Lung wrests the medallions, but cannot avert history's tragedy.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley. A team of swordswomen led by Liu wants to get their hands on the treasures before the bandits, but both parties will have to contend with the wandering swordsman Chou for them...

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou's brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become “The Five Shaolin Masters”.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Wealthy heir Ping Chien Jen spurns the family business for a travel agency with his girlfriend Su Yung Lan. While they are hosting visitors from Hong Kong, a student falls for Chien Jen, sparking tension. Consumed by jealousy, Yung Lan storms off, and the student crashes her car after learning of his engagement. Misunderstandings are eventually cleared, and happiness follows.

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiao's Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is deceived when Xiao poses as an ally to try and steal his Blade in the process.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Duke's daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score “The Proud One”. Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang's father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally beats Ouyang Ke to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Carefree drifters Meng Gang and Tie Hu discover their purpose after meeting the revolutionary leader, Wan Tai. With the help of Meng Gang's girlfriend, they infiltrate a warlord camp to seize weapons for the revolutionary cause. Following a fierce battle, all three make the ultimate sacrifice, becoming the "Anonymous Heroes" of the revolution.

programme.title: Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: Hsiao Shi Yi Lang is the Swordsman at large who everyone wants to kill. A magnificient sword is even created for this purpose though the blade is soon coveted more than the swordsman's death by it! Bandits, beauties and blade masters battle for survival in this exciting story of deceit, betrayal, and death.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the master's granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves; a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not being executed; and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: Two royal brothers are separated as babies after a traitorous general usurps the throne. Raised apart, one within Shaolin Temple and the other by a noble lord, they grow into formidable martial artists. When destiny reunites them, the brothers must combine their deadly kung fu styles to overthrow the tyrant and avenge their fallen empire.

programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man…

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: The Mad Monk (1993)
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Yat Mei and his disciples live in a remote village until Sister Maria restores an abandoned church, awakening a long-dormant vampire missionary. As panic spreads and Taoist exorcism fails, Yat Mei joins forces with a Western priest, combining Eastern and Western powers to battle evil.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Undercover police officer Shan is sent to prison to befriend crime boss Tin and gather evidence. After Tin’s release, Shan helps him rise through the ranks by eliminating rivals. But when his contact with police arouses suspicion, Shan’s cover is exposed, leaving him in a deadly predicament as a secret that could change everything emerges.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man’s matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man’s matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition – he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch—but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur…

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: After his father's death, the impoverished Kwan moves to the provincial capital and works at a textile workshop run by his late father's friend, retired martial artist Tuen. As a ruthless Manchu warlord exploits martial arts tournaments to expand his criminal influence, Kwan and his allies become entangled in a dangerous fight for justice.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: Sent to Japan by his master, Chen Zhen rescues and falls in love with fellow student Hiroko Yamada, only to be drawn into the Black Dragon gang's conspiracy. As Chinese students disappear and Jing Wu Martial Arts School comes under attack, he joins Liang Shao Wen to destroy a secret lab, foil the conspiracy, and defend his nation's honour.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Infernal Affairs II
programme.desc: In this prequel, the secrets of “Infernal Affairs” are revealed - the resentment between police superintendent Wong and crime boss Sam, as well as the beginning of the parallel fates of the two moles, Yan and Ming. The keys lie in the hands of Sam's wife, a ruthless kingpin and a righteous cop.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father’s land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora’s Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Blinded on a counter-terrorism mission, former SWAT captain Dong Gu retires and lives with his daughter. When his old nemesis resurfaces and kidnaps her for an underground trafficking ring, Dong Gu must rely on his heightened hearing and formidable combat skills to hunt down the criminals and rescue his daughter.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend. Both are discovered by Danny Lee, a handsome young explorer who brings the odd couple back to Hong Kong, where Evelyne

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Chore Score Dew Drop Swap
programme.desc: On Harper’s first allowance day, the pets accidentally knock Harper’s Piggy Bank over and lose one of her quarters that she was reserving to buy Nicholas an ice cream cone. Now the Dew Drops must scramble to replace it! When the Dew Drops struggle to help their kids with tasks that are outside their usual fairy-bilities, they decide to swap kids for the day, but ultimately learn they’ re exactly where they need to be because they know their families so well!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Full House Gift Express
programme.desc: Nicholas keeps stuffing oversized objects inside Eden’s fairy home. But it creates a BIG problem when Harper’s family wants to visit grandma and the car keys are nowhere to be found! When Harper gets sick, Marcus builds a pulley between their apartments to send Harper treats. But when Qwak, the chipmunk, breaks the pulley, the Dews must step in to keep the treat train running.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Salty and Sweet Cruz Blues
programme.desc: Chef J tells Ollie he cooks with love. Kelp and Ollie set out to make food with love for him. When various food combos fail, Ollie considers giving up, because it isn’t good enough. Kelp goes to his Dad for answers, and two seemingly different ingredients form something magical. When Cruz is not his usual upbeat self, Kelp tries various ways to cheer him up before realizing the best way to be a good friend is to just sit with him, and let him feel what he’s feeling.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Pet Sitters Narwhalicorn Day
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop pet-sit Crabby, who acts out until they realize he’s missing home. Kelp feels like he can’t choose between a celebration on land or under the sea. So he attempts to do both... at the same time!

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S2 - CJ WooferbugWhat Did I Miss
programme.desc: DJ is excited to give her niece CJ her own wooferbug for her birthday. But the wooferbug proves difficult to transport across Trolls Village. Will DJ be able to get it to CJ before CJ’s birthday party ends?When Peppy takes an entire day to get a new haircut, he asks Poppy to fill him in on what he missed. What follows is a series of short sketches, as we explore an average day in Troll Village.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - It Takes Ahhh Valley Part 1 & 2
programme.desc: When the Croods return to Ahhh! Valley they find that the evil Brood family has taken over and Grug must work with fellow Valleyites to defeat them

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Gruff Around The Edges
programme.desc: When a distant cousin of the Twins named Gruffnut arrives on Dragon's Edge, Tuffnut tries to impress him, but Gruffnut may not be the hero he seems.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Picture Perfect
programme.desc: Tim and Boss Baby want to bond with Dad by recreating a perfect "Dudes Weekend' camping trip, culminating in a photo opp, but everything seems to go wrong

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Puppy Party!
programme.desc: Boss comes face to face with his old nemesis;Bug The Pug;after the playgroup parents decide to throw a Puppy Party. Staci creates a “No-Paperworkist” movement to avoid Buddy From HR’s constant paperwork.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - The Big Break
programme.desc: Boss thought that breaking his arm was painful;but the true pain starts at pediatrician Dr. Kevin’s “jokes.” Boss enlists the playgroup babies to defang the doctor of his “comedian’s disease.” Tim obsesses about keeping his little brother safe.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Ga Ba Goo Ba Ga (The Babblist)
programme.desc: There’s a new “babblist” in town- someone who claims to understand baby talk. Boss Baby spots this fraud right away;and must debunk his tactics before he scams the playgroup parents. Meanwhile;Tim tries to sell magazines with Boss Baby’s help.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Bossa Nova
programme.desc: After Boss Baby is fired from Baby Corp;he attempts to navigate regular baby life in a MommyDaddyBaby playgroup. Even worse;the playgroup’s other new member is Mega Fat;whose animatronic stuffie Wagby malfunctions and threatens the safety of the whole group. Meanwhile;Tim does everything he can to avoid doing his homework.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Wrinkles & Stickles
programme.desc: After Turtleneck is captured by Frederic Estes, Boss Baby and Tim attempt to rescue her, leading them to the terrifying "fun house" at the town fair

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - Stink of Fear: Chapter Four
programme.desc: Director Peachfuzz recruits Rocky and Bullwinkle to help her infiltrate Fearless Leader’s hideout, and Boris and Natasha are replaced by a robot henchman

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Enter The Fanaloka
programme.desc: The evil genius Karl sets out to destroy King Julien. When both Clover and Maurice are captured, King Julien must save them from his new nemesis.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Empty Is The Head
programme.desc: Exhausted from settling his subjects' disputes, King Julien replaces himself with a dummy king so he can play hooky, unwittingly sparking a rebellion.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - It's A Secret Queen Of Thighs
programme.desc: Oh cannot keep a secret when Tip tells him she's planning a surprise partyLucy's “Queen of Thighs” video goes viral and turns her into a celebrity.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Krunkle Krush Beauty Tip
programme.desc: Tip spies on Oh when he has his first date with a strange Boov named Krunkle.Tip competes against rival Pom Pom Pappernacky in a beauty pageant.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Legend of Master Long-Tooth
programme.desc: Po and Blade must convince a deceased comic book writer's son to give them information about an unreleased comic that may point them toward the next weapon: a whip of fire. However, after the events of 103 Po is now a wanted criminal, so the Emperor's Forbidden Company arrives and captures him. Torn between saving Po and the mission she's sworn to complete, Blade flees and abandons Po.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Gateway to The Desert
programme.desc: A mysterious figure helps Po escape the guards, so Po makes his way to a desert market, determined to prove Blade wrong for leaving him behind. But when he accidentally stumbles into Klaus and Veruca, he and Blade awkwardly reunite while giving chase, and work through their differences. But the mysterious figure has followed Po and tries to capture them, clearly a new threat to our team.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Lost City
programme.desc: With a map from the comic book, Po and Blade make the treacherous journey through the desert to the lost city, and once inside they find the guardian of the fire whip, Rukhmini. The mysterious figure, a stag named Colin, forges an uneasy alliance with Klaus and Veruca.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Pie Hard
programme.desc: After a back-breaking day of farm chores, all Grug and Phil want is a slice of pie. But when there is only one slice left, both Grug and Phil argue that they deserve it more. To prove who works harder, Grug and Phil switch chores on the farm for a day.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Snack of Dawn
programme.desc: Dawn is bummed when an injury prevents her from joining the Croods and Bettermans to a trip to Fizzy Falls, but when Thunk recruits her on his quest for an ancient stash of legendary snacks, Dawn can't resist joining the treasure hunt.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Fam Farm Fun Fest
programme.desc: Believing he doesn't fit in on the farm, Chunky (aided by the other pets) leaves home to follow the distant call of another death cat. The kids set off to bring him back home. Note: Gran narrates the story.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Snowed In
programme.desc: The team uncovers the person behind the Incineration Day theft: General Dudley! While tracking him down, they’re led into an ambush in the Swiss Alps. Is the general just a pawn in a larger plan?

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Rafaela’s Raf-venge
programme.desc: The team realizes that they’re being led on a wild goose chase and that the person behind it all must be the one and only Rafaela! She’s broken out of prison and is now causing havoc in Berlin using the dangerous stolen spy tech – which makes her more formidable that ever before.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Fun on the Autobahn
programme.desc: The search for the Incineration Day tech continues and Frostee thinks he’s finally figured out who’s behind the whole thing: his little sister, Sissy! programme.title: The Last Breakthrough - EP9
programme.desc: Dr. WONG PO FUN (CHEUNG KA FAI, NICK) joins "Life Force", an international medical humanitarian organization, to carry out the unfulfilled wish of his deceased girlfriend, TUNG (LEUNG WING KEI, GIGI). He also sets up "Lung Shing Medical Centre" to help the poor. Influenced by FUN, HANG joins "Lung Shing" later.

programme.desc: 人间卫视不同于其他电视台定位，一向致力于打造媒体新视野，并期许为新闻界注入一股清流。《人间新闻》此次改版，将再提升新闻品质与水准，落实公益电视台的媒体责任。《人间新闻》报导的焦点包含慈善公益、社会关怀、文化艺术、人文教育、心灵提升、健康医疗、环保议题等内容，借由这些新闻与专题报导，将传递真善美的人间清流，提供观众更广阔的新闻视野，与世界脉动接轨。

programme.title: 另一种注目第11集

programme.title: 人生调色盘第305集
programme.desc: 歌仔戏小生陈亚兰小姐首次独挑大梁，主持深度人物访谈节目【人生调色盘】。 「人生」问题是一门大学问，悲欢离合、生老病死是每个人会经历的过程，特别是随著社会发展而衍生出新的问题，例如职场与网路的霸凌、忧郁症、亲人失智长照…等，都是过去所罕见的。 节目透过嘉宾的经验分享，辅以专家学者从旁论述分析，掌握选择的思考过程，厘清正确的观念，借以产生改变自己的能量。主持人陈亚兰也发挥歌仔戏隐恶扬善的精神，将「忠孝节义」的处世准则，于节目中传播出去。 为了推广台语之美，特别规划「亚兰话俗语」单元，每集介绍一句台湾俚俗语，简单直白却字字珠玑，不仅学习到老祖宗的智慧，也贴近自己的人生。

programme.title: 2026安乐富有系列讲座第25集
programme.desc: 2026安乐富有系列讲座

programme.title: 鲁蛇玩很大第243集
programme.desc: 《鲁蛇玩很大》来宾以年轻创业者为主，也涵盖少数中壮年龄层，他们以过来人的角度，回溯过去创业初期失败的经历，回首来时路，发现不同时代的做梦者，其实都需要同样的勇气和意志。这些人都曾面临「失败、低潮」，但最终挺过黑夜，迎来阳光。他们将在节目中分享一路走来的心路历程，让观众除了看见成功者光鲜亮丽的表象，也看见新创背后，所需要的苦功与深层思考。在节目中，有许多精心安排的巧思：「快问快答」让观众在短时间内快速认识各集来宾、「给年轻自己的一封信」以过来人的身分，给予当时的自己与现在的年轻人最真切的忠告与期勉，最后「对十年后自己的期许」请来宾分享未来展望。万事起步难，聆听他们分享创业初期的甘苦谈，创业时面临

programme.title: 人间新闻
programme.desc: 人间卫视不同于其他电视台定位，一向致力于打造媒体新视野，并期许为新闻界注入一股清流。《人间新闻》此次改版，将再提升新闻品质与水准，落实公益电视台的媒体责任。《人间新闻》报导的焦点包含慈善公益、社会关怀、文化艺术、人文教育、心灵提升、健康医疗、环保议题等内容，借由这些新闻与专题报导，将传递真善美的人间清流，提供观众更广阔的新闻视野，与世界脉动接轨。

programme.title: 九局之外第1集
programme.desc: 以棒球场外人生故事为核心的运动娱乐访谈节目，传达「在九局终局之后，才是真实人生的开场」之理念，带领观众深入球员与球团的内心世界。

programme.title: 人生调色盘第305集
programme.desc: 歌仔戏小生陈亚兰小姐首次独挑大梁，主持深度人物访谈节目【人生调色盘】。 「人生」问题是一门大学问，悲欢离合、生老病死是每个人会经历的过程，特别是随著社会发展而衍生出新的问题，例如职场与网路的霸凌、忧郁症、亲人失智长照…等，都是过去所罕见的。 节目透过嘉宾的经验分享，辅以专家学者从旁论述分析，掌握选择的思考过程，厘清正确的观念，借以产生改变自己的能量。主持人陈亚兰也发挥歌仔戏隐恶扬善的精神，将「忠孝节义」的处世准则，于节目中传播出去。 为了推广台语之美，特别规划「亚兰话俗语」单元，每集介绍一句台湾俚俗语，简单直白却字字珠玑，不仅学习到老祖宗的智慧，也贴近自己的人生。

programme.title: 梵音清流第7集
programme.desc: 此音只应天上有，人间哪得几回闻。」「梵呗」就是清净之意，除了耳根享受之外，最主要的仍在心灵的清净，歌咏时还伴以管、弦或敲击乐器，普及佛教教义。

programme.title: 河洛歌仔戏-【台湾我的母亲】
programme.desc: 由作家李乔同名文学著作改编的《台湾，我的母亲》，描述清末民初唐山过台湾、来台开垦的彭阿强一家人，为守住土地与天灾搏斗、与叶阿添交结清朝贪官、日军侵略等恶势力抗争的历史故事。令人感受台湾先民“唐山过台湾，心肝结归丸”的艰辛历程。

programme.title: 文艺赋格第12集
programme.desc: 融合在地与全球，开拓多元丰富的文化景观。如同音乐「赋格」一般的创作形式，众声云集，成就台湾文艺的合唱。

programme.title: 艺海扬芬第2集
programme.desc: 「艺海扬芬」是文化部国立新竹生活美学馆推动的「百年公会堂人物影像民族志」计划。它以影像纪录与刊物出版的方式，记录台湾北部九县市资深艺术家的创作轨迹与生命故事，借此传承珍贵的艺术文化资产。计划已访谈并记录多位不同领域的艺术家，透过纪录片与专刊让大众认识这些对文化传承有重大贡献的人物。

programme.desc: 歌仔戏小生陈亚兰小姐首次独挑大梁，主持深度人物访谈节目【人生调色盘】。 「人生」问题是一门大学问，悲欢离合、生老病死是每个人会经历的过程，特别是随著社会发展而衍生出新的问题，例如职场与网路的霸凌、忧郁症、亲人失智长照…等，都是过去所罕见的。 节目透过嘉宾的经验分享，辅以专家学者从旁论述分析，掌握选择的思考过程，厘清正确的观念，借以产生改变自己的能量。主持人陈亚兰也发挥歌仔戏隐恶扬善的精神，将「忠孝节义」的处世准则，于节目中传播出去。 为了推广台语之美，特别规划「亚兰话俗语」单元，每集介绍一句台湾俚俗语，简单直白却字字珠玑，不仅学习到老祖宗的智慧，也贴近自己的人生。

programme.title: 情比姊妹深第8集
programme.desc: 黎兰章出生于南部农家，从小跟著父亲做农，结婚后家庭幸福美满，孰料先生早逝，她独力抚养两个孩子，这段期间兰章受到朋友同事的关心与照顾，才能度过人生的低潮，为了回馈社会的爱心，兰章加入了慈济。因受到上人的感召，兰章自认文的不会，武的也不会，只会做环保。兰章十几年不感动许多志工纷纷加入，但困难的是始终没有固定的环保点，她的坚持与不退，感动了丽梅师姊，提供固定的场地给兰章做环保，也终于不用再流浪。她们用做环保来实践上人的法，也吸引了很多志工加入，兰章跟丽梅认为环保道场就是人间净土，也是她们及志工们的心灵修道场。

programme.title: 行动现场第546集
programme.desc:
爱，不漏接，做，就对了！
台湾社会贫富悬殊、强弱失衡，现有政策与资源难以弭平，在国家发展到了一定程度后，最终希望世界大同、人人平等，迈向福利理想国，但社福法规、人力、经费及各方资源都不足分配，无法周全，得靠民间力量自我体现，多少填补缺口。慈济志工为数甚众，是台湾最有组织与规模的NGO，借由众多的人间菩萨散布各乡镇村里，或许能照顾到乏人闻问的黯淡角落。
我们希望提供一个行动平台，让各方NGO团体无论大小，以及无分年纪与工作的爱心公民，参与分工这张绵密的爱心网，网住所有被制度漏接、需要帮助的人。

programme.desc: 青春爱读书 开启年轻阅读新风潮 青春爱读书，看年轻人读什么书！

programme.title: 证严上人说故事第286集
programme.desc: 听故事，曾经是儿时最大的期待。好听的故事，更是百听不厌、刻骨铭心。 《证严上人说故事》是证严上人从多年生活历练中摘取得来的智慧结晶。在一则则风趣浅白故事中，她告诉我们，在生命的经营里，如果被『名』枷『利』锁绑住，而失去心灵空间，那将是一种无法弥补的损失。

programme.title: 风月同天第35集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 大爱真健康第1051集
programme.desc: 运动是对自己最好的投资，不只是为了瘦身、增肌，是为了更好的生活品质，每一天做一件对自己好的事，日子就会很踏实。 运动是一辈子的事，没时间运动不是借口，每天花三~五分钟时间，跟著「大爱真健康」做运动，让你愈动愈年轻、愈动愈健康！

programme.title: 29放光慈济60特别节目-48分版第2集

programme.title: 365日日素第378集

programme.title: 证严上人说法华第27集
programme.desc: 汇整历年法藏，重现智慧法语。《证严上人说法华》精选晨语开示，提纲挈领导读《法华经》核心精神。此经誉为诸经之王，上人致力将深奥教义化为现代「菩萨道」，以实践足迹印证经文，强调「不只诵经，更要行经」。透过浓缩法要，引领大众深入浅出体悟教菩萨法，让历久弥新的法髓延续灵山感动，回归清净本性。

programme.title: 守护大自然第1集
programme.desc: 印尼原住民族世代与自然共存，以传统智慧守护森林、海洋与土地。面对开发变迁，仍坚守文化及生态平衡，为后代留下珍贵传承。

programme.title: 人间菩提

programme.title: 大爱午安新闻 LIVE
programme.desc: 证严上人慈示：「新闻报导，除了『报』，还要进一步『导』，范畴要开阔，关怀普天下苍民，为时代作见证，为人类写历史。」，大爱新闻透过SNG、电话连线、数位影像，传递全球最新讯息，坚持将人间美善讯息与人性光明面的故事至散播世界各地，发挥净化人心功能。

programme.title: 志为人医守护爱2.0第181集
programme.desc:
什么是有温度的医疗？什么是医疗之魂？医疗团队除了在诊间、在手术室、在病房抢救生命之外，还能做些什么？
『志为人医守护爱』带您目击动人的温馨医病情现场，透过医疗团队的视病如亲、 以病为师的坚持、病患与医疗团队的互相感恩，体会与感受现代人医如何帮助病患重拾信心，在他们人生低潮时重新出发，进而走入人群，自助助人。

programme.title: 行动现场第544集
programme.desc:
爱，不漏接，做，就对了！
台湾社会贫富悬殊、强弱失衡，现有政策与资源难以弭平，在国家发展到了一定程度后，最终希望世界大同、人人平等，迈向福利理想国，但社福法规、人力、经费及各方资源都不足分配，无法周全，得靠民间力量自我体现，多少填补缺口。慈济志工为数甚众，是台湾最有组织与规模的NGO，借由众多的人间菩萨散布各乡镇村里，或许能照顾到乏人闻问的黯淡角落。
我们希望提供一个行动平台，让各方NGO团体无论大小，以及无分年纪与工作的爱心公民，参与分工这张绵密的爱心网，网住所有被制度漏接、需要帮助的人。

programme.title: 情比姊妹深第8集
programme.desc: 黎兰章出生于南部农家，从小跟著父亲做农，结婚后家庭幸福美满，孰料先生早逝，她独力抚养两个孩子，这段期间兰章受到朋友同事的关心与照顾，才能度过人生的低潮，为了回馈社会的爱心，兰章加入了慈济。因受到上人的感召，兰章自认文的不会，武的也不会，只会做环保。兰章十几年不感动许多志工纷纷加入，但困难的是始终没有固定的环保点，她的坚持与不退，感动了丽梅师姊，提供固定的场地给兰章做环保，也终于不用再流浪。她们用做环保来实践上人的法，也吸引了很多志工加入，兰章跟丽梅认为环保道场就是人间净土，也是她们及志工们的心灵修道场。

programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: MIT台湾志第749集
programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 花甲少年趣旅行第16集
programme.desc: 2位花甲明星＋2位少年偶像，跨龄差距的结伴青春旅行，走访在地文化行销台湾，世代差异的旅游个性激荡出充满意外性的实境自助旅行。当稚嫩少年遇上犀利花甲，会擦出什么火花呢?这是一段花甲老熟肉与少年小鲜肉们，跨越大龄差距，结伴而行的明星青春旅行。到底小鲜肉们想什么？而老熟肉们又会怎么玩？透过世代差异，激荡出观众意想不到的旅行火花！全台唯一全明星跨世代旅游实境节目，纪录跨世代的艺人们难忘的友情之旅！从陌生到熟悉！ 从畏惧到麻吉！让小鲜肉成长！让老熟肉回春！不啰唆！现在出发吧～

programme.title: 阿叔第40集
programme.desc: 剧情讲述王识贤饰演才气纵横而心高气傲，且心中似乎隐藏著什么大秘密的「木工修复师」，该戏探讨如何借由这项逐渐没落的工艺修补众人的羁绊，再创台湾传统文化的价值，也将体现台湾小镇浓厚的人情味。平凡写实的小人物故事、真挚的情感，绝对令人又哭又笑！

programme.title: 警世剧场第40集

programme.title: 咱的城 咱的市 咱台湾的味第3集
programme.desc: 台湾是个美丽的宝岛，一年四季都有不同的景色以及不同的物产，从本岛到离岛各地皆拥有自己独特的味道，而更为人所津津乐道的除了台湾的美食，台湾的人情味更是世界闻名。 这次【咱的城 咱的市 咱台湾的味】将带观众环岛一周，以及去到澎湖及金门，走入各地的市场，以不同的饮食文化、季节性产物、店家手路菜、创意料理等角度，带领大家了解各地美食背后的文化底蕴，增广对当地饮食文化的认识，也增加节目的丰富度及视野。

programme.title: 包青天第147集
programme.desc: 包拯为北宋仁宗天圣五年（1027年）申科进士甲科，初任建昌知县，官至开封府尹及龙图阁大学士，这跟电视上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中国清官的典型代表，后世包括朱熹、欧阳修、司马光对他都有正面评价。宋仁宗年间，开封府尹包拯，通称「包青天」。为官清廉，为民伸冤，强调「人在做天在看」、「举头三尺有神明」不畏强权，除恶务尽。较脍炙人口的单元有「秦香莲」、「真假状元」、「狸猫换太子」等。

programme.title: 谁来晚餐17第12集

programme.title: 残值第1集
programme.desc: 阿滨达到了40岁的年纪，从未想过自己也能拥有像圣人一样的力量，只要轻轻一签字，就能拯救许多人的性命。这份工作并非单纯的职业，当你拥有决定他人生死的能力时，你的存在变得无比重要。对于一个境况不佳的保险专员阿滨来说，至少西哥的话说服了他。西哥是个放高利贷的人，他从阿滨身上嗅到商机，希望解决自己手上一大堆烂帐。西哥愿意支付保费，而借款者则以他们的一部分贷款来交换。

programme.title: 转学生第1集
programme.desc: 家里不给换新单车的小四生阿智，正准备避开同学耳目、牵他那台破烂淑女车回家的时候，新转来班上的女生宜臻，就这么闯进他的世界。逐渐熟络起来的两人，三不五时就由阿智带头干点小坏事，继杂货店顺手牵羊未遂事件后，宜臻的单车又被网咖外的国中生干走，两人于是合力沙盘推演，用冲天炮声东击西，顺利抢回单车。阿智和宜臻好像因此建立了革命情谊，从单纯的两小无猜，晋升成一种懵懵懂懂的感受；在这个凯旋归来、一车双载的夜晚，他们更加靠近，并说好隔天一起上学。翌日，宜臻却爽约了，阿智在她家门外探头探脑，看见已被清空的住宅，才知道她假装开玩笑说的又要转学，原来是真的。阿智牵起宜臻留下的单车，用她的生日打开密码锁，稚嫩的心灵似

programme.title: 我们的岛第1383集
programme.desc: 一个一小时的节目，能带给观众什么，能影响什么？如果把它只当成一个节目，会感觉短短一小时很短暂，如果把它当成一条出路，会发现力量也可以很强大，一直以来，我们节目的理念就是寻求一种改变的可能性，只要有一个人因为看过报导而改变了，反省也好，感动也好，警惕也好，行动也好，就有可能形塑一种新的环境公民力量，也有可能让错误的政策不再继续。1998年11月1日「我们的岛」节目正式播出，当年台湾的环境还处于大肆开发的年代，在经济挂帅的氛围中，「我们的岛」为环境发出另一种声音，至今「我们的岛」仍是台湾媒体中，唯一以「环境」为报导主题的新闻性节目，也是公共电视开播以来历史最久的新闻性节目，这十五年「我们的岛」制作

programme.desc: 公共电视新闻部的十多名记者与工作人员，将回到自己的频道，开辟一个兼具调查采访和新闻杂志性质的新闻专题节目，「独立特派员」。 调查性或杂志型态的电视新闻专题节目，往往是一个电视台的新闻实力指标。为了在公共电视开辟调查性的新闻专题节目，服务更多观众，我们将以「新闻专题节目的领导品牌」为目标，回到公视频道制播独立、深度的调查性报导，以及提供多元、宽广视野的新闻专题。

programme.title: 只是一阵一阵第1集

programme.title: 暗潮第1集
programme.desc: 故事叙述有轻微身心障碍的高中生永展在河边溺毙，检方与法医勘验后，将以无他杀，意外溺毙结案。发现疑点的林母不满，独自展开调查。经过各方推理，林母始终查不出儿子的溺毙原因。告别式后，一切似尘埃落定。事实真相在永展姊姊莉薇于二轮戏院观影中的内心回忆，方才揭露出来，但这个秘密将永埋于她幽暗心灵角落里，不为人知。

programme.title: 行走TIT第363集

programme.title: 浩克慢游第16集

programme.title: 暗夜新闻第332集
programme.desc: 暗夜客话新闻是全国唯一主播、记者以全客语发音的新闻频道，并 详实显示字幕，除了著眼于「客家观点」的重要新闻议题、呈现客家生活 习俗与传统文化之外，更尽力发掘社会各阶层客家乡亲的故事。暗夜客话新闻针对四节新闻播出镜面，以桐花、蓝衫等各种不同主题的客家元素为基础，作全面的视觉设计，让收视大众们能够耳目一新、零时差的掌握，最具客家观点的新闻呈现。

programme.title: 泣声初试第4集
programme.desc: 迎接新生儿，以及举行命名仪式，是人们庆祝孩子到来的重要活动。即使在今天，许多地方的人们，仍以传统文化上独有的方式，实践著表达迎接新生喜悦的古老传统。本节目将走访述印尼、印度、菲律宾和新加坡，记录孩子出生的一些独特习俗。

programme.title: 老派美学的约会第6集
programme.desc: 以美学出发的节目，借由主持人米莎拥有建筑底蕴和丰富的旅行、阅读经验来解读日常生活中的美学，也擅用米莎音乐人的背景带著音乐美学走进客庄，拉近和乡亲的距离。

programme.title: 客客客栈第1集
programme.desc: 提到「客家」，你会联想到什么？硬颈精神、勤劳节俭、客家美食，还是满天飞舞的桐花？而「客家」，又是怎么来的呢？又有什么样有趣的小故事？

programme.title: 【客家艺视界】自然有声第1集
programme.desc: 人类寄情于景，又以歌声临摹山水之音，自然里有景、有情、有乐音，声景交融，为视觉与听觉的交响盛宴；除了以「自然」为引、以《诗经》为题的两首客语委创作品首演外，亦将节目策画为有形自然的和无形自然等两项概念：有形的「自然有声：山水寄情」－安排国人创作的合唱作品，以声见景、见山、见海、见百年参天老树。

programme.title: 音乐关键字第5集
programme.desc: 生活里无处不在的声音，其实是最浪漫的科学—换个方式「尞／聊」音乐。提到音乐，多数人总以为那是右脑的事，是抽象的知觉、感性的领悟，但其实音乐也有它很左脑、很理性、很科学的一面。生活里无处不在的声音，其实是最浪漫的科学。

programme.title: 音乐关键字第8集
programme.desc: 生活里无处不在的声音，其实是最浪漫的科学—换个方式「尞／聊」音乐。提到音乐，多数人总以为那是右脑的事，是抽象的知觉、感性的领悟，但其实音乐也有它很左脑、很理性、很科学的一面。生活里无处不在的声音，其实是最浪漫的科学。

programme.title: 国际新闻-客观世界第325集
programme.desc: 是一个专注于国际时事的新闻节目，以客观、中立的角度报导全球各地的重要新闻事件。节目内容涵盖政治、经济、社会、文化等多方面的议题，旨在向观众传递真实可信的消息，让观众全面了解世界各地的动态，增进对国际事务的理解和视野。

programme.title: 聚焦国际第755集
programme.desc: 国际局势多变，身为地球村的一员，这些国际时事的演变，值得我们深入观察与追踪。为了呈现最具客家观点的国际时势分析，客家电视推出全新节目《聚焦国际》，共有三大主题，分别是「本周封面」、「寰宇新知」跟「新闻幕后」。

programme.title: 河中巨怪第4季:第4集
programme.desc: 杰洛米韦德来到北印度，四年前他在这里钓到一条超大鱼怪，坦克鸭嘴鱼，自此以后便开始在全球搜捕淡水河怪。这次印度跟东南亚又传出有别的水中生物攻击人类，据说是叉尾鲶。但在捕捉之前，他必须觐见一位印度圣者，因为他要捕鱼的河是印度圣河恒河，而要钓的鱼也是神的使者，但圣者告诉他，捕捉叉尾鲶只会带给他厄运，因为这种鱼其实是神明给人的恩赐。后来因为雨季提早来临，杰洛米转向泰国捕捉叉尾鲶，在泰国钓到各式各样的稀有河中巨怪，但就是不见叉尾鲶的踪影，印度圣者的警告是否将千里之外喜马拉雅山的厄运带来此地？最后杰洛米决定面对心魔，回到印度捕捉叉尾鲶。

programme.title: 追谜探险队第4季:第2集
programme.desc: 乔许前往英国研究神秘纪念碑巨石阵的起源。

programme.title: 层层透视古文明第5季:第3集
programme.desc: 迈达斯王金手指的故事在希腊神话中知名度数一数二，传说往往多少包含几分真实性，虽然点金术听来像是幻想，但是否可能有事实根据？考古学者在古都戈迪恩的遗址发现耐人寻味的线索，显示传说的描述或许对应了真实事件。敬请锁定本节目，揭开迈达斯王传说背后的真相。

programme.title: 旧货猎人修复篇第5季
programme.desc: 德鲁普里察精挑细选古董旧货，交给工匠团队巧手修复，赋予全新生命。他们将看似无用的旧物修复成赚钱宝物，虽然客户挑三拣四，但潜在利润惊人。

programme.title: 原始生活21天第10季:第7集
programme.desc: 本集节目共有三位参赛者。法兰克足智多谋，茱莉亚是求生传奇崔西的女儿，继承了母亲的勇猛，史考特虽冲动但毅力惊人。三人合作唯一的缺点就是食物要分成三份。

programme.title: 理查哈蒙玩很大第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 这次理察哈蒙要前往墨西哥湾的超大油气平台，认识由重型机具构成的巨大厂房和集合住宅，如何遗世独立运作，又能稳定漂浮在水面。这座巨型海上工厂面临许多独特的挑战，搬运所有物资和零件都得靠吊车进行，每周运来的食材补给也不例外。为求日以继夜输出天然气与石油，所有机具故障都得当场解决，员工待在平台上的时间还比回家多。此外，设备所耗费的大量电力也需要以喷射引擎和蒸气自产。想要达到日产能的目标，这些条件缺一不可。

programme.title: 抢救脱网族-强行介入第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 不愿承认失败的脱网族万万没想到，亲人竟然背地找人出手介入。面对全新的生存挑战与棘手的情绪问题，瑞尼一家奋力抢救的不只是濒临崩溃的脱网家园，还有支离破碎的家庭关系。

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第14季:第16集
programme.desc: 本集节目介绍蜡笔、金属镜和无链条脚踏车的制作。蜡笔是将石蜡熔融，加入色素和水调色，再灌入模具制成。金属镜的材料是铜锡构成的青铜合金，先将黏土制成模具，再将合金块置于模具上方的小杯，封闭后经过熔融自然流入模具，凝固后取出抛光，再与特制镜框结合便完成。无链条脚踏车是用驱动轴取代链条，组装车体时，将镶齿与轴装在车轮中间，再连接踏板与车轮，并装上挡泥板、拨叉和把手便完成。

programme.title: 金矿的赌注-前进旧矿区第3季:第9集
programme.desc: 在本集中，图林团队终于来到觊觎已久的圆丘开采，但这里的矿砂黑砂量过高，导致溜洗槽阻塞，黄金可能流失；另外由于戴夫嫌麻烦不愿铺路，负责运矿的KC得在下雪天应付颠簸的运料道，冒著时时可能翻车的风险往返。

programme.title: 金矿的赌注-前进旧矿区第3季:第10集
programme.desc: 在本集节目中，戴夫图林在科罗拉多的圆丘奋力淘金，试图突破本季目标，当地社群和特殊黑砂却不断阻挠。

programme.title: 瑞典边境护卫队第2季:第2集
programme.desc: 机场海关查获一名从非欧盟地区入境的旅客携带大量香烟、水烟烟草跟妈妈味料理。

programme.title: 金帝手工车厂第9季:第4集
programme.desc: 戴夫和凯文第一次参加俄亥俄州诺瓦克的蓝色麂皮游轮车展，要在车展中选出一辆绝世靓车，并首度举办金帝车厂精描图著色比赛。

programme.title: 河中巨怪第4季:第2集
programme.desc: 这集的河中巨怪中，杰洛米将带大家前往位于俄罗斯东部偏僻地区的黑龙江，准备调查一起三名渔夫溺毙的事件，这三名渔夫相约前往黑龙江出海口捕鱼，结果却不幸溺毙，一年后才寻获其中两人的尸体，但第三具尸体始终未能寻获。杰洛米抵达俄罗斯后，虽然感到大家都很友善，但始终无法问出关键线索，所幸后来前往一鱼类加工厂时，工厂经理总算透漏，有条大鱼就藏身码头附近，他利用工厂排出的鱼尸块钓起一条鲶鱼，但在见过密沙后，密沙的叙述听来又不像是鲶鱼，反而更像是鲟龙鱼，再经确认他才确定黑龙江中真正的河怪，其实是体型更大的达氏鳇，但因达氏鳇体内可取得非常珍贵的鱼子制成鱼子酱，因此从苏联瓦解后，盗猎的问题就如燎原野火般一发不可收拾

programme.title: 河中巨怪第4季:第3集
programme.desc: 这集的河中巨怪中，杰洛米将前往从未去过的蒙古地区，搜寻一种从小令他著迷的河中巨怪哲罗鲑。他曾看过一则传闻，有条哲罗鲑巨怪受困冰中，一群牧人一片片割下巨怪的肉食用熬过冬天。但春天雪融后，哲罗鲑巨怪爬上陆地把这群牧人全都吃下肚。尽管故事过于牵强，却清楚呈现当地人如何看待这种鱼。到了蒙古后，他发现以往打听目标的常用方法完全不管用，因为蒙古人对鱼或钓鱼都一窍不通，完全没有渔猎文化。所幸他仍找到向导詹嘉愿意协助他猎捕哲罗鲑，到达第一个扎营地后，詹嘉透露的一次经验让杰洛米吓出一身冷汗，因为詹嘉曾在他们扎营的地方遭人伏击。虽然对方只是开枪警告，但这种经验仍让杰洛米倍感压力。展开钓鱼几天之后，虽然陆续钓起了一

programme.title: 远古未解之谜第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 本节目简述四桩古代谜团的破解过程，一并介绍最新考古研究领域与科技。从复活节岛著名头像的树立位置、澳洲内陆的古代凶杀案、希腊爱琴海底的神秘机械装置，到非比寻常的慕尼黑干尸，考古涉及的应用领域越来越多，技术也日新月异。许多以往认为无解的谜题，因此有了惊人进展。

programme.title: 理查哈蒙玩很大第1季:第9集
programme.desc: 理察哈蒙回顾自己造访过的超大工程，分析这些巨无霸如何型塑当今世界，在经营上又会遇到哪些挑战。人工智慧在许多巨型工程中已经无法或缺，鹿特丹货柜码头几乎已完全自动化，德国福斯车场则持续探究人机如何共事以增进效率。东西越大，需要应付的自然能量也越可观，从阿尔卑斯山下的铁路隧道、到维修超大运输机油箱的机棚，人类都不断发明创新方法，来克服地球上的种种难题。总归起来，巨无霸在营运维系上总少不了人类悉心呵护。

programme.title: 河中巨怪第4季:第4集
programme.desc: 杰洛米韦德来到北印度，四年前他在这里钓到一条超大鱼怪，坦克鸭嘴鱼，自此以后便开始在全球搜捕淡水河怪。这次印度跟东南亚又传出有别的水中生物攻击人类，据说是叉尾鲶。但在捕捉之前，他必须觐见一位印度圣者，因为他要捕鱼的河是印度圣河恒河，而要钓的鱼也是神的使者，但圣者告诉他，捕捉叉尾鲶只会带给他厄运，因为这种鱼其实是神明给人的恩赐。后来因为雨季提早来临，杰洛米转向泰国捕捉叉尾鲶，在泰国钓到各式各样的稀有河中巨怪，但就是不见叉尾鲶的踪影，印度圣者的警告是否将千里之外喜马拉雅山的厄运带来此地？最后杰洛米决定面对心魔，回到印度捕捉叉尾鲶。

programme.title: 野地造屋第5季:第1集
programme.desc: 世界各地都有令人叹为观止的造屋工程，包括在阿拉斯加海拔二千多米的冰川上搭建求生小屋、为座落于天涯海角的灯塔进行修复工程、在安伯格里斯岛上一个远离人烟的沙滩上打造私人渡假天堂、在阿拉斯加的蛮荒之地打造家园以抵御灰熊侵袭，以及在爱达荷州一条隐世的「不归河」畔建造小木屋。在不同的极端环境下造屋，团队面临各种高难度挑战，但惊险过后，一切努力都没有白费。

programme.title: 旧矿区新财路第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 艾力克斯与凯文再次来到亚利桑那州普雷斯科特附近，要协助麦克,杰夫与葛雷格兴建选矿厂。这三个人有三个金矿场，需要选矿厂来提出黄金，但受限于资金用罄，选矿厂缺临门一脚才能完成，故向艾力克斯与凯文求助。两人受到它他们的认真态度以及可能的赚钱潜力吸引，帮忙建立放置颚压机的基脚台、连接各碎石机之间的输送带、替离心机搭盖防阳光棚等等，让选矿厂顺利运转。

programme.desc: 戴夫团队决定在季终前五周，提前离开无矿地可开采的科罗拉多州，回到成军首季开采的山猫溪矿区，力图挖到价值百万的黄金总量。在戴夫复垦原矿地的同时，杰森与KC谈成了山猫溪全境的开采权，并和其他成员完成前置作业。尽管探勘时遭遇波折，他们首次秤金便获得相当不错的成果。

programme.title: 飞车追逐实录第2季:第6集
programme.desc: 刚到班的菜鸟警察，在进行第三个月的实地训练时遇到了偷车事件，而且没想到还演变为飞车追逐，带来了一个震撼教育。

programme.title: 到美国结婚去-最后一搏第3季:第12集
programme.desc: 夏卡娜与萨波因情绪失控爆发而缺席团体活动。

programme.title: 小镇翻修趣第6季:第14集
programme.desc: 年轻夫妻档菈狄珍奈与洛坚育有两子，两人想替孩子奠基而准备第一次购屋。艾琳与班带他们看了两个符合预算的物件，最终由有门廊的房子雀屏中选。因夫妻俩热爱鲜艳色彩，艾琳得以在屋内使用各种新颜色。班则与乔许一起打造了屋外的特色饰件与让孩子很开心的双层床。

programme.title: 亚洲房屋猎人第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 阿黛儿自从16岁开始就梦想拥有自己的家，如今35岁的她已经准备好迈出一大步购买自己的房子。

programme.title: 亚洲房屋猎人第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 马来西亚的亚文和玲要找一栋新房子，由于家族人多这个五口之家需要可以容纳十口人以上的房子。亚文和玲能否找到梦想中的房子，有足够的房间来容纳他们的大家族？

programme.title: 省钱出绝招第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 维多利亚是个白手起家的百万富翁，她坚持记下生活中的每一笔开销，甚至要她男友史提夫试著搬过来同居，测试他是否能配合她的「不冲水生活」：用尿壶上完厕所后倒进花园里，这样每个月可省下2块美金。维多利亚每年只需花费12000美元（包括所有帐单、日常用品，以及健康保险），因为她用定时器让冰箱每天只运转12小时，而且为了省水、省电，永远只在健身房冲澡。

programme.title: 省钱出绝招第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 住在南达科塔州的阿布度买东西一定要杀价，连加油都要求店家把零头去掉。小器的的阿布度打算用25美元，也就是区区750元台币的预算，帮老婆办一场结婚周年派对，他的杀价功夫能帮他达成任务吗？而住在爱达荷州的薇琪，为了5个小孩省吃俭用。家里连电话都不装，全家人还会开车在路上捡拾被车撞死的动物，新鲜的动物死尸会煮来吃，毛皮则做成小饰品，完全不浪费。

programme.title: 全美梦幻婚纱第1季:第10集
programme.desc: 蓝迪认为洛艾莉丝不仅是代表纽约州的最佳新娘人选，她甚至可以代表全美。小时候就跟著妈妈移民美国的她因为妈妈后来生重病，童年时不得不与弟弟往返于数个寄养家庭，后来她成为护士在自己长大的社区服务。当初要找黑色婚纱的崔西今天来试婚纱，没想到却认为自己预定的婚纱颜色不够白？

programme.title: 大天空厨房第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 主厨艾德华多贾西亚举办自制披萨派对。他准备手工面团、红酱与青酱，让宾客随心搭配丰富配料，亲手打造专属的披萨杰作。

programme.title: 大天空厨房第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 主厨艾德华多贾西亚与妻子在野外健行垂钓后，回府准备惊喜晚餐。他精心烹调扇贝、玉米粥与妻子最爱的鲜奶油起司派，共度浪漫约会。

programme.title: 亚洲房屋猎人第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 阿黛儿自从16岁开始就梦想拥有自己的家，如今35岁的她已经准备好迈出一大步购买自己的房子。

programme.title: 亚洲好住家第5季:第5集
programme.desc: 环球旅行家阿曼多完成他的环球旅行之后开始工作，但工作竟然又带他回到他环球旅行的起点—中国。

programme.title: 亚洲好住家第5季:第6集
programme.desc: 我们跟随世界各地的房屋买家，看著他们克服在亚洲买房的重重难关。

programme.title: 低预算造街区-纽奥良第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 艾凡与凯斯面临严重的财务危机，必须运用设计巧思与省钱妙方，快速吸引买家上门。

programme.title: 改造滞销屋第4季:第1集
programme.desc: 琳西和莱丝莉接手一栋1960年代的房子却面临艰巨的买方市场，双胞胎姊妹将它改造成充满有机感的现代杰作，但卖掉这间房子是她们迄今为止最困难的挑战。

programme.title: 厨房翻车现场第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 露营野炊火势大升温、婚礼蛋糕惨烈崩塌。看众多顶级名厨给出最即时的精彩反应。

programme.title: 厨房翻车现场第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 惨烈翻车的美食灾难接连爆发，交织成又一波网路疯传的奇葩瞬间。

programme.title: 双强设计家第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 雷与艾琳要替雷的挚友吉尔伯特与葛瑞丝翻修门面与后院，并且应要求共同设计整体工程。

programme.title: 风城改造专家第4季:第6集
programme.desc: 室内设计师兼开发商艾利森维多莉亚，在家乡芝加哥进行老屋翻新。面对客户的个别挑战，在紧凑工期与有限预算下，寻找独特物件、精心设计，让每个空间重新绽放新生命。

programme.title: 装修首购屋第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 莱莎和奥斯汀要翻新一间百年老宅，满足首次购屋的屋主的所有需求仿佛是在挑战两人设计能力的极限。

programme.title: 厨神当道亚洲版第1季:第10集
programme.desc: 最后一道餐点、最独特的创意，最后只有一人能夺得厨神当道亚洲版的冠军。

programme.title: 哈利波特-烘焙巫师第3季:第4集
programme.desc: 邀请多位《哈利波特》明星重返片厂，鉴赏由世界各地烘焙好手制作出色香味俱全、充满魔法造型的甜点

programme.title: 海滩生活不插电第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 本集委托人是妮可与拉齐姆夫妇。他们来到加拿大新斯科细亚省寻找理想的房屋。第一栋是豪尔海湾海滩屋，有他们喜爱的高挑天花板和开放式的隔间设计；第二栋是熊角屋，有超酷的私人海滩跟梦想中的套房卫浴主卧室；第三栋是海滩草坪屋，农舍风格十分吸引人，室内充满意外惊喜。三栋房屋都在与世隔绝的地点、享有绝佳的奢华海景，他们会如何选择？

programme.title: 海滩生活不插电第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 两位冲浪客到哥斯大黎加的偏远地区寻找美丽的滨海房屋。丛林房屋最便宜，但要骑马才能到海边；雨林天堂直逼预算上限，却临近私人海滩；价位中等的帕文天堂，附近有世界级冲浪点，买家该如何抉择？

programme.title: 全美梦幻婚纱第1季:第11集
programme.desc: 盛大联合婚礼终于完美落幕，蓝迪与海莉抽空坐下来好好回顾整个活动的精采过程。从蓝迪一开始全美跑透透突击新娘到四十几位新娘涌进克莱菲尔婚纱店要迅速找到梦幻婚纱中间发生的各种插曲、婚礼前一天的扮装派对、婚礼当天的发妆事件都是有趣的回忆。蓝迪也对每一位新娘有更深认识，并从活动中体认到从事婚纱业的意义。

programme.title: 杰与潘蜜拉第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 节目聚焦一对很特别的情侣杰与潘蜜拉，两人都罹患罕见的脆骨症。

programme.desc: 玛芙扎与内莉面临著斑色鱼鳞癣的残酷考验。
